'''1997 Dagobah Regionals (Orlando)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], one of three in the Dagobah region (Georgia, Alabama, Mississippi, Florida).<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Dagobah)
* '''Date:''' 12 October 1997
* '''Site:''' Holiday Inn - Arena, Orlando, Florida
